### Introduction

BASGRA is a mechanistic model for grass growth. The PEcAn package `PEcAn.BASGRA` provides integration with the PEcAn workflow system.

### Installation

```r
# Install from r-universe
options(repos = c(
  pecanproject = 'https://pecanproject.r-universe.dev',
  CRAN = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
install.packages('PEcAn.BASGRA')
```
